title: Billie Holiday with the band
summary: Billie's stint was short; Helen Dance says Billie told her Freddie was the only man she really loved.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: Well, you haven't said anything about Billie Holiday, and Helen Humes.
Well, that time when Billy was with the band, I mean, the band was just sounding wonderful. Wasn't it?
You were at the Famous Door, and then you went out on the road.
And, it only lasted about six to eight months, didn't it? How long did it last?
I don't think it lasted that long.
Do you think it lasted longer than that?
No. I don't think it lasted longer than that.
No. It didn't last too long.
Why did you he let her go?
I don't know. I really don't know. I don't remember.
Well, I think that -- you know -- that Billy was ruled by her feelings, and it was very hard for her --
-- to always have her feelings in check. To perform every night under certain circumstances.
It was something that she wasn't cut out to be and do.
And, I think that -- you know -- that she felt that what she felt was right, and didn't like to be told -- you know -- what she felt instinctively was right. You couldn't persuade her that it wasn't.
And, in a sense she was correct about that.
But, for Basie as a leader, it wouldn't really work. Maybe it might have worked for Basie, but it wouldn't work for the office, would it?
You know? I think they grumbled, didn't they?
Well, I have to -- one thing I have to say, Freddie, you know, is that -- you know -- we were friends -- Billy --
We were friends. And, Billy always told me that the only guy she really loved was you.
Now that -- I always thought it was very sad, because -- you know -- so that was in the early part of her career.
I mean -- you know -- the way Billy spoke to me, you know, was if she could have -- she and Freddie could have made it, but, Freddie was married.
And, if she and Freddie could have made it, you had the feeling that Billy could have been happy, and this is what she wanted. And, maybe it's true.
You never know in your life, do you? Who --
-- who you can make it with in life.
Well, wasn't she supposed to be very fond of Lester, too?
No, I don't think so. I don't know whether -- you know -- what went on between --
-- Lester and Lady -- you know. But, they were close, you know, as friends, you know.
Yeah. Yeah. Well, it's funny, isn't it, because, you know -- I mean -- all Billy's different things that she had --
-- you know -- after -- there was something wrong with different situations, you know --
-- and she was never -- never really happy. But, she was really happy --
Well you're putting that on the tape, Freddie's hot.
(laugh) No -- I'm not -- I'm not going to get into that. (laugh).
(laugh) No, I don't blame you. We're talking about Billy
(laugh) It's okay for you to say what she told you.
Well, I said -- Fred's going to do things the way he wants to (laugh).
You know -- he can say what he wants to.
